- [LERR.1.4.3] Division, floor-division or modulo of `Int` operands by
  zero ([LEXP.7.15.1]). A `Float` division by zero returns `±Inf` or NaN
  ([LDET.3.6.2]).

idris.name: lexp_7_15_1__int_zero_divisor_traps
idris.note: Division, floor division and modulo of Int operands by zero are a trap for every dividend. The Float half (±Inf or NaN) is `lexp_7_3__float_op`'s for the three operators; the evaluator's one trap kind does not say ComputationError.
